SELECT cls, fish_date_doy, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 45 AND 60 AND cls IN ('hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','three_quarter')
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY cls, fish_date_doy
SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE avail_season=6 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 8
